an6.32:3.2: “Tonight, a glorious deity, lighting up the entire Jeta’s Grove, came to me, bowed, stood to one side, and said to me:
an6.32:3.3: ‘Sir, these six things don’t lead to the decline of a mendicant.
an6.32:3.5: Respect for the Teacher, for the teaching, for the Saṅgha, for the training, for diligence, and for hospitality—
an6.32:3.6: These six things don’t lead to the decline of a mendicant.’
an6.32:3.8: Then he bowed and respectfully circled me, keeping me on his right side, before vanishing right there.
